title: Compound Visualization
description: Explore more than 40 molecules and crystals, switch rendering styles, inspect atoms and bonds, measure geometry, and search PubChem.

prompt.objective: Build an interactive molecular viewer for exploring compounds, crystals, atoms, bonds, and geometry.

mintAssets.brief: Matte, satin, glossy, and metallic scientific surfaces.

experience: Browse bundled structures and search PubChem for more molecules.
Inspect atoms and bonds, then measure distances and angles.
Switch render modes, labels, spin, backgrounds, and export.
prompt.visualDirection: A restrained dark scientific workspace with floating glass panels, precise typography, and vivid CPK atom colors.

thumbnail.alt: A ball-and-stick caffeine molecule surrounded by composition, measurement, and structural-library controls.

social.title: Compound Visualization
social.description: Inspect and measure molecules and crystals in an interactive 3D chemistry workspace.
